nodes.name: exploreDataHelpers.ts
nodes.summary: Low-level JSON/text parsing helpers (record type guards, JSON-like parsing, recursive text/file extraction) used by the explore-result extractors to interpret raw agent tool outputs.

nodes.name: exploreResultExtractors.ts
nodes.summary: Extracts structured results (LSP diagnostics, cat/glob/search outputs) from raw explore-tool events for the SessionReplay explore panel.

nodes.name: exploreTypeResolver.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves whether an IDE tool event belongs to the explore panel and maps its action/tool name to an ExploreType enum value.

nodes.name: fileConverter.ts
nodes.summary: Converts raw IDE tool events (read/write/edit/multi-edit) into normalized FileOperation records, including unified-diff parsing.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the file/shell/explore event-to-operation converters for the SessionReplay module.

nodes.name: listDirParsers.ts
nodes.summary: Parses list-directory tool results (text lines or tree-node JSON) into normalized directory/file line arrays for the explore panel.

nodes.name: shellConverter.ts
nodes.summary: Converts raw shell/terminal IDE tool events into normalized ShellOperation records with resolved command and status.

nodes.name: deduplication.ts
nodes.summary: Deduplicates streamed file, shell, and explore operations by call id / content so the SessionReplay timeline shows one entry per logical action.

nodes.name: fileTreeUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Builds, sorts, filters, and flattens a hierarchical file tree from a flat list of file operations for the SessionReplay file sidebar.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level SessionReplayIDE component that orchestrates the Code Editor session-replay simulator: wires operation selection, tabs, sidebar config, and live/replay state into the shared WorkStation shell.

nodes.name: asRecord
nodes.summary: Type guard that returns a value as a plain record only when it's a non-null, non-array object.

nodes.name: parseJsonLike
nodes.summary: Attempts to JSON.parse a string value, returning the original value unchanged if parsing fails.

nodes.name: firstString
nodes.summary: Returns the first string-typed value found on a record across a list of candidate keys.

nodes.name: firstNumber
nodes.summary: Returns the first valid numeric value found on a record across a list of candidate keys, coercing string digits.

nodes.name: extractStringArrayFromSource
nodes.summary: Extracts and filters a source value down to an array of strings.

nodes.name: extractTextBlocks
nodes.summary: Recursively extracts all readable text blocks (content/observation/message/output fields) from a nested tool-result source.

nodes.name: extractFilesFromSource
nodes.summary: Recursively extracts a flat list of file path strings from a nested tool-result source (files/directories/matches/items fields).

nodes.name: extractTextFromResult
nodes.summary: Joins the text extracted from a tool-call result's success/output/message fields into a single string.

nodes.name: extractSearchRowsFromSource
nodes.summary: Recursively extracts normalized search-result rows (file, line, snippet) from a nested search-tool source.

nodes.name: isSearchOutputPath
nodes.summary: Heuristically determines whether a line of plain-text search output represents a file path rather than a message or tool name.

nodes.name: parseTextSearchResults
nodes.summary: Parses plain-text grep/glob/search output into a structured list of results and matched file paths.

nodes.name: extractManageWorkspaceResults
nodes.summary: Parses manage_workspace tool output text into a list of file rename/move operations.

nodes.name: parseLspDiagnosticsText
nodes.summary: Parses raw LSP diagnostics text output into deduplicated file and diagnostic entries.

nodes.name: extractLspCheckedFiles
nodes.summary: Determines the set of files an LSP check tool call inspected, from its arguments or result payload.

nodes.name: extractLspResults
nodes.summary: Builds the full LSP explore-operation result (checked files, diagnostics, raw content) from a tool event's args and result.

nodes.name: extractCatResults
nodes.summary: Extracts and truncates the file content returned by a cat/read tool call for display in the explore panel.

nodes.name: extractGlobResults
nodes.summary: Extracts the list of matched file paths from a glob tool call's result.

nodes.name: extractSearchResults
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized search rows and matched files from a code-search tool event's result.

nodes.name: extractStandardSearchResults
nodes.summary: Central parser that normalizes a search/grep/glob tool result (JSON or plain text) into a standard {results, files} shape, handling multiple result schemas.

nodes.name: isExplorePanelTool
nodes.summary: Determines whether a given tool function name belongs to the explore panel's supported tool set.

nodes.name: resolveExploreType
nodes.summary: Maps a tool function name and its action argument to a specific ExploreType (lsp, cat, glob, search, list-dir, etc.).

nodes.name: parseUnifiedDiffPayload
nodes.summary: Parses a unified diff string's hunk headers and lines into separate old/new content, line numbers, and change counts.

nodes.name: resultHasRealDiff
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool-call result actually contains diff/edit data rather than being empty.

nodes.name: shouldTrustDiffStartLines
nodes.summary: Decides whether the diff's reported start-line numbers should be trusted based on hunk headers and result content.

nodes.name: parseFilePath
nodes.summary: Splits a full file path into its file name and containing directory.

nodes.name: convertToFileOperation
nodes.summary: Converts a raw read/write/edit/multi-edit IDE tool event into a normalized FileOperation, including diff payload resolution.

nodes.name: parseTextListDirLines
nodes.summary: Parses plain-text list-directory output into separate sorted arrays of directory and file lines.

nodes.name: extractListDirLinesBeforeDisplayCap
nodes.summary: Extracts the full (pre-display-cap) directory and file line arrays from a list-dir tool result, supporting both text and tree-node JSON formats.

nodes.name: extractListDirResults
nodes.summary: Produces the display-capped directory/file line arrays and truncation flag for a list-dir tool result.

nodes.name: commandFromAction
nodes.summary: Derives a display command string for a shell tool event from its action arguments (command, script, or process name).

nodes.name: convertToShellOperation
nodes.summary: Converts a raw shell/terminal IDE tool event into a normalized ShellOperation with resolved command, status, and output.

nodes.name: stripFileOperationPayload
nodes.summary: Strips the heavy content/diff payload from a FileOperation, keeping only lightweight metadata.

nodes.name: dedupeFileOperations
nodes.summary: Groups and deduplicates streamed file operations by file path, keeping the latest meaningful diff per file and stripping payloads from superseded entries.

nodes.name: getShellCallId
nodes.summary: Extracts a stable call id for a shell operation from its related event ids.

nodes.name: getShellContentKey
nodes.summary: Builds a dedup key for a shell operation from its call id or command+timestamp.

nodes.name: dedupeShellOperations
nodes.summary: Groups streamed shell operations by content key and keeps the most complete entry per group.

nodes.name: dedupeExploreOperations
nodes.summary: Groups streamed explore operations by normalized query and keeps the most complete entry per group.

nodes.name: buildFileTree
nodes.summary: Builds a nested directory/file tree structure from a flat list of file operations, then sorts and compacts single-child directories.

nodes.name: compactSingleChildDirs
nodes.summary: Recursively merges directories that contain only a single child directory into a combined path segment.

nodes.name: sortNodes
nodes.summary: Recursively sorts file tree nodes, directories first, alphabetically by name.

nodes.name: filterFileTree
nodes.summary: Recursively filters a file tree down to nodes whose name or path matches a search query.

nodes.name: flattenFileTree
nodes.summary: Flattens a file tree into a depth-annotated list, skipping children of collapsed directories.

nodes.name: countFileNodes
nodes.summary: Recursively counts the number of file (non-directory) nodes in a file tree.

nodes.name: SessionReplayIDEComponent
nodes.summary: Top-level component implementing the Code Editor session-replay simulator: derives replay state via useCodeEditorReplay, manages tab/sidebar/selection state, and renders the shared WorkStation IDE shell with file/explore/shell/tool panels.
